codex-storyatlas-root — FINAL FORWARD REVIEW of embed-core d8b727b / W1-W2 on main b9a8b44. Read-only; no source edits. Scala-console adversarial constructions were run against the compiled JVM APIs.

P0-1 — PseudonymizedText is forgeable, so Sanitized is not a proof. privacy.scala:45-51 has a public case-class apply/copy; contract.scala:176-192 trusts Sanitized unconditionally; privacy.scala:103-132 authorizes it. Repro: PseudonymizedText(policy,key,raw clinical text,Vector.empty) passed preflight for Remote/PublicOnly and RemotePolicy.evaluate returned Right. Bead bd-01M1508AMPV3KR6JAYFZ3SS2MF. Law: external construction/copy must fail; checked pseudonymizer output must validate ordered, bounded, code-point-safe offsets; a raw-surface laundering fixture must be rejected.

P0-2 — sensitive receipt surfaces are still unkeyed. contract.scala:83-109 uses Checksum for AttemptReceipt; privacy.scala:51 and :65-75 use Checksum for the pseudo/capability digest; baselines.scala:40-62 emits ordinary ProviderCall input/output checksums for sensitive material. Repro: pseudo.digest exactly equalled Checksum.ofText(policy + NUL + keyId + NUL + text). Bead bd-01M1508J0F8ZAMHH3G9X20W8ZV. Law: every sensitive cache/capability/attempt/provider-call identity is a typed HMAC digest; different KeyIds differ; missing key never falls back; receipts contain neither text nor key bytes.

P0-3 — the ModeGate is internally applied but its scientific result is forgeable. hsmm.scala:123-140 exposes HsmmResult; matrix.scala:115 and :226 expose AlignmentRow/AlignmentMatrix constructors and copy; signature.scala:52-58 consumes any HsmmResult. Repro constructed faithfulMass=1.0 with admissibility=Map.empty, without calling GraphHsmm. Bead bd-01M1508SVEZB9DBEG3F9XYR1GK. Law: only GraphHsmm or a validator proving posterior-state subset of admissibility can create the gated result; forged/copy-mutated/decoded matrices cannot feed RecallSignature.

P1-1 — GeometryPair validates less than its declared contract. identity.scala:310-328 compares provider/dimension/normalization/truncation and only latePooling.matryoshkaDimension. Repro accepted tok-a/window128/mean/PartialCoverage against tok-b/window64/max/Missing. RemotePolicy also does not prove request.space belongs to the provider/model. Bead bd-01M15090X6JVTHM8ETWTF4T671. Law: mutate every compatibility-key field; reject unless a named asymmetric-pair rule explicitly permits it.

P1-2 — one structurally malformed provider outcome poisons valid siblings. contract.scala:152-170 replaces the entire batch when BatchResult.conforms finds one bad id/space; a three-item repro with only item 2 wrong returned Invalid for all three. Bead bd-01M150991YYSS01Q9NZFSWFYB0. Law: decide fail-closed versus index-local recovery explicitly; mutation tests for one wrong id/space, missing, duplicate, and extra outcome must never misassociate vectors.

P1-3 — segment structural match, chart coverage, and provider coverage are conflated. cost.scala:242-295 uses coverage * best + missing * 0.5; source.scala:172-188 counts charts, not successful provider estimates. Repro: one exact + one missing chart gave 0.25; adding a role-reversed chart with pair distance 0.4 improved the segment to 0.0. A provider abstaining on that second chart also returned 0.0 while coverage reported 2/2. Bead bd-01M1509H7NE4PCJ3H7W1RB6G4D. Law: reducer/missingness separate; retain member/reducer receipt; properties cover incompatible additions, provider abstention, permutation, leaf equivalence.

ACCEPTED CONTROLS: ProviderFingerprint versus GeometryId identity split and per-component IDs; ValidatedVector/ValidatedDistance checks; MaterialDigest.Sensitive HMAC primitive/cache key and missing-key failure; normal provider failures versus Estimate.Missing; GraphHsmm state construction and refinement operate only on prepass-admissible states; absent d_chart/d_wl terms are inert and recorded. The defects above are boundary/estimand holes around otherwise sound internal mechanics. Chief: please disposition/assign the six routed beads; the three privacy/gate findings are P0.
